prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1047; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's okay. You already have it on the file.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were a passenger in the vehicle involved in the collision at the intersection in Houston, Texas?
A: Yes, I was in the front passenger seat. My friend was driving.
Q: Can you describe what happened as best you remember?
A: We were going through a green light and another car came from the left side and hit us right on my side of the car. The impact was really loud and the whole car shook.
Q: Did you hit anything inside the vehicle, or did your head move in any way?
A: My head snapped to the right and then back. I hit the window frame with my shoulder. I didn't lose consciousness, but I was dizzy for a few minutes.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the accident?
A: Yes, the ambulance took me to the emergency room. They gave me a neck brace and took X-rays. They said it was a soft tissue injury, probably whiplash.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?
A: Yes, my neck is stiff and hurts when I turn my head. I get headaches at the back of my skull, and my shoulder is sore when I lift anything heavy.
Q: Have you been seeing a doctor or physical therapist since then?
A: I've been going to physical therapy three times a week. I also have a follow-up with my primary care doctor next week.
Q: Did you miss any work because of your injuries?
A: I missed a few days at first because I couldn't sit at my desk for long. I'm back now, but I have to take breaks often.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble sleeping because of the neck pain. I'd appreciate it if this could be handled quickly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
